title: The 3 Best Juicers for Small Kitchens
h1: The 3 Best Juicers for Small Kitchens
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for juicers for small kitchens, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at juicers for small kitchens using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hurom H-AA Slow Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: Single auger, upright design, 150W quiet motor, Adjustable pulp control lever.
strengths: Vertical stacking design uses far less counter length than a horizontal masticating juicer
Quiet motor is a real advantage in a small apartment kitchen with shared walls
High juice yield despite the compact body, no performance tradeoff for the smaller footprint
limitations: Highest price of the group, a real consideration for a smaller secondary appliance
Narrower feed chamber than wide-chute centrifugal juicers means more pre-cutting
More parts to store separately if it doesn't live permanently on the counter

products.name: NutriBullet Juicer Pro NBJ50200
products.blurb: Key specs: 1000W high-torque motor, 27oz sealing juice pitcher, 3-inch feed chute with dual-size pusher.
strengths: Fewest parts to disassemble, making it the fastest to put away in a cabinet after use
Sealing pitcher doubles as fridge storage, useful when counter space is limited
Lower price makes it a reasonable secondary appliance in a small kitchen
limitations: Wide feed chute needs more clearance to operate than the Hurom's chamber
Centrifugal motor housing is bulkier than an equivalent masticating auger body
Lower yield than masticating options, meaning more storage-and-retrieval cycles for the same amount of juice

products.name: Breville Juice Fountain Cold
products.blurb: Key specs: 850W motor, Cold Spin Technology, 70oz juice jug.
strengths: Wide feed chute takes whole produce, trading counter space for less prep work
Large 70oz jug means fewer stops to empty during a session
Easy rinse-clean design, useful when kitchen counter space for drying racks is limited too
limitations: Largest footprint of the three options here, both while running and in storage
Louder motor, a consideration in an apartment with close neighbors
Bulkier housing takes up more cabinet space than the others when stored

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
